text: Apex Realty Group office is open Monday to Friday 8:30am-6:30pm and Saturday 9:00am-5:00pm, Sunday by appointment. We service the entire Greater Metro area, including downtown, northern suburbs, and coastal neighborhoods. This is an interactive demo of our AI Real Estate Receptionist.

742 Evergreen Terrace: Beautiful 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom single-family suburban home with 2,200 sq ft, upgraded quartz kitchen, private landscaped backyard, and 2-car garage. Listed at $650,000. Private tours can be booked daily, and an open house is held every Saturday 1-4 PM.

1204 Grand Avenue, Unit 8B: Modern downtown luxury loft featuring 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1,400 sq ft, 11-foot exposed ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows with skyline views, and deeded underground parking. Listed at $440,000 with low $320 monthly HOA.

88 Ocean Pointe Drive: Premium coastal 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath estate with 3,600 sq ft, private boat slip, heated pool, chef's kitchen, and expansive master suite balcony. Listed at $1,250,000. Verified pre-approval or proof of funds requested prior to private showings.

450 Maple Court, Unit 3: Spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath rental apartment, newly renovated with stainless appliances, in-unit washer/dryer, and pet friendly. Rent is $2,400 per month, 1-year lease minimum, available for immediate move-in.

For buyers, our agents provide complete end-to-end guidance: personalized MLS search portals with instant off-market alerts, neighborhood valuation reports, private showing coordination, offer negotiation, and escrow coordination. Buyer representation is typically at zero direct cost to the buyer.

For homeowners looking to sell, we provide a complimentary, no-obligation Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) and home valuation report. Listing packages include professional HDR photography, drone footage, 3D Matterport virtual tours, social media campaigns, and staging consultation.
Our standard full-service listing commission is competitive at 2.5% to 5% total split, with flexible tiered marketing plans tailored to each property's price point and seller timeline.

Our lead agents include Marcus Vance, Senior Broker and Residential Specialist with 14 years of metro real estate experience, and Elena Rostova, Luxury Property Specialist and Investment Advisor with 9 years of experience. Both take direct buyer and seller consultations.

We partner with top-rated local mortgage lenders who can issue verified conventional, FHA, VA, and jumbo loan pre-approvals in under 24 hours. Pre-approval clarifies your buying power and makes offers significantly stronger.
Private showings can be scheduled any day between 9:00 AM and 7:00 PM with at least 2 hours advance notice. We verify the buyer's contact details and email before locking in the showing appointment.
